ui.guard.indicator_sharing_pending: Guard: sharing with {org} · new items waiting for your choice
ui.guard.indicator_waiting: Guard: {org} is waiting for your choice
ui.guard.indicator_will_ask: Guard: {org} will ask you again soon
ui.guard.reason_console_revoked: you stopped sharing from Console on {date}
ui.guard.prompt_reason_widened: {org} wants to collect more: {scopes}. Until you choose, Guard keeps sharing only what you already agreed to.
ui.guard.prompt_reason_reactivated: {org} turned Radient Guard back on. Nothing is shared until you choose again.
ui.guard.prompt_reason_plan_gap: {org}'s Team plan lapsed and restarted, so Guard needs your answer again. Nothing is shared until you choose.
ui.guard.prompt_reason_new_device: This is a new computer for your Radient account. You choose per computer, so choose for this one.
ui.guard.prompt_reason_rejoined: You rejoined {org}. Your earlier answer ended when you left, so choose again.
ui.guard.prompt_would_send: From this computer, Guard would send:
ui.guard.scope_decisions: Guardrail results: whether each check allowed, asked or blocked, and the rule type
ui.guard.scope_posture: Setup checks: whether recommended settings are on. Each computer randomises its answers before they leave, so admins see estimates, not anyone's real answer. Admins may be able to tell when one of these settings changes on your computer.
ui.guard.scope_task_time: Task time, in ranges such as 5–15 min
ui.guard.scope_review_cycles: Review rounds per change, and whether it merged or closed
ui.guard.scope_reports: Reports you choose to send, such as a suspected exposed key or too much blocking. {org} admins see only how many of each kind were sent, and only for a kind that at least 5 people sent that day. No one at {org} can open your report. Radient staff open a report only when you ask us for help with it or the law requires it.
ui.guard.scope_trace_detail: Step-by-step timing of your tasks, without content (kept 14 days)
ui.guard.scope_admin_share: Let {org} admins see your step-by-step timing
ui.guard.prompt_never_sent: Never sent: file paths, commands, prompts, code, model output or tool arguments.
ui.guard.prompt_visibility: Admins see totals only when at least 5 people contributed, never your own numbers.
ui.guard.prompt_visibility_posture: Admins see totals only when at least 5 people contributed, and setup-check estimates only when at least 20 did. Never your own numbers.
ui.guard.prompt_visibility_admin_share: Admins see totals only when at least 5 people contributed. With step-by-step timing shared, they can also see your own timing, but not what the steps contained.
ui.guard.prompt_visibility_admin_share_p: Admins see totals only when at least 5 people contributed, and setup-check estimates only when at least 20 did. With step-by-step timing shared, they can also see your own timing, but not what the steps contained.
ui.guard.prompt_background: After you answer, this runs in the background. You can stop anytime in Settings or in Console.
ui.guard.screen_none: No organization has asked you to share Guard stats.
ui.guard.revoke_body: Guard stops sending from all your computers now.
ui.guard.revoke_body_trace: Guard stops sending from all your computers now and deletes your step-by-step timing. Copies in backups are gone within {backup_days} days.
ui.guard.revoke_retained: Other records you already sent stay until they expire: stats after 90 days, reports after 180 days.
ui.guard.revoke_totals: Past totals that included you stay published. They never show you on your own.
ui.guard.card_title: Radient Guard is part of Radient Team
ui.guard.card_body: Radient Team is for software factories, consulting teams and knowledge work done as a team. Agents share context and hand work between people, and Guard gives admins guardrail stats from members who opt in.
ui.guard.screen_failed: Your choice wasn't saved, so nothing changed. Try again.
ui.guard.screen_unavailable: Guard can't read its settings on this computer. Nothing was shared or sent from this screen.
ui.guard.screen_unconfirmed: We couldn't confirm your choice. Check Guard in Settings before trying again.
ui.guard.screen_prompt_changed: {org} changed this request. Check the new one below.
ui.guard.badge_waiting_aria: {count, plural, one {# Guard question is waiting for your answer} other {# Guard questions are waiting for your answer}}
